title: Хикару и го OVA
originalTitle: Hikaru no Go: Sabaki no Ikkyoku! Inishie no Hana yo Sake!!
alt: Hikaru no Go Special / Match of Justice! The Ancient Flower Blooms!! / Jump Festa 2002 Hikaru no Go Special ヒカルの碁 特別編 - 裁きの一局! いにしえの華よ咲け!!

en:
Alternate version of the story featured in episode 64 that was shown at Jump Festa 2002 and later included with the DVD-BOX.



Unlike the TV series which is digitally processed, this episode is shot on cels.
ja: ヒカルの碁 特別編 - 裁きの一局! いにしえの華よ咲け!!
